forecast_horizon: last 2 tubelet slots = last 4 frames of a 16-frame clip
clip_rule: fixed 96x96 window centred on a tracked cell at the clip's first frame; candidates every 16 frames along every track; up to 256 per movie and stride, seeded (seed 20261019)
static_control: frame 11 (the last context frame) repeated 16 times
context_swap: context of another clip from the same movie (seeded cyclic shift); scored against the true clip's targets
slot_mean_baselines: mean target latent per future slot (and per slot x spatial position), fitted on the other half of the movies (2-fold); the better of the two is the reference
pixel_check: ridge (lambda 10) from LayerNorm-ed target latents to the 4x4 pooled pixels of each future tubelet patch, fitted on 40,000 tokens of the other half of the movies
statistics: 6 movies < 10 groups: per-movie values and exact sign-flip tests over movies, no confidence intervals
leakage: TiJepa-0's corpus contained the twin of 08_H4.ome.zarr.zip; that movie is excluded from every TiJepa-0 summary
